title: Task 3: Add D&D SRD rules adapter and Pathfinder ORC fixture
description:
Objective:
Represent both existing D&D SRD content and a real Pathfinder 2e Remaster ORC fixture as rules packs.

Files:
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/dnd5eSrd.ts`
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/pathfinder2eRemaster.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/srd/data.ts` only if adapter needs shared constants
- Modify: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/rulesFixtures.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing tests that `DND5E_SRD_RULES_PACK` validates, `PATHFINDER2E_REMASTER_RULES_PACK` validates, both have distinct `systemId` values, and Pathfinder fixture license metadata identifies ORC-licensed source material.
2. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesFixtures.test.ts`; expected: FAIL because fixture exports do not exist.
3. Implement the D&D adapter by mapping current SRD monsters/spells/classes to provider-neutral rules records without deleting existing SRD exports.
4. Implement a small but real Pathfinder fixture from ORC-licensed Remaster rules content with records needed by later character generation tests: at least one ancestry, one background, one class, one feat, one trained skill/proficiency concept, one equipment item, and one spell or cantrip when applicable.
5. Include explicit source and license metadata on every pack and record.
6. Export fixture packs from `packages/core/src/index.ts`.
7. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesFixtures.test.ts`; expected: PASS.
8. Commit with `git add packages/core/src/rules packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/test/rulesFixtures.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-add-rules-system-fixtures`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesFixtures.test.ts` passes. D&D and Pathfinder packs both validate, have distinct identities, and include source/license metadata.
close_reason: Added DND5E_SRD_RULES_PACK adapter over SRD_CATALOG and a compact ORC-licensed PATHFINDER2E_REMASTER_RULES_PACK fixture (ancestry/background/class/feat/equipment/spell). Verified: focused rulesFixtures.test.ts passes (9/9 RED→GREEN), full npm run typecheck and npm run test pass (362 passed, 2 documented skips).
